name: Pseudo Cpp
description: Readable C++ in Binary Ninja: try/catch from exception tables, readability passes on HLIL
longdescription: Adds a "Pseudo Cpp" language representation for native code. Planned: try/catch rebuilt from the compiler's exception tables (Itanium LSDA, MSVC EH) and readability passes on HLIL (ternaries, boolean returns, x++ as a value, loop conditions, folded temporaries). Sister project of binary-jvm.
author: patrick
